result.topic_en: Riemann argues that two expansions of a fractional derivative that agree for all values of (x+h) must be identical, since the constants arising from integration (polynomial complementary terms) must all vanish; he then notes that a value of the derivative is determined only up to a term K x^{ν-n}/Π(-ν-n).

methods.what: Lower-order derivatives/integrals of two determinations differ by polynomials of integration constants
Summation of the double series of constant terms into binomial form (x+h)^{ν-m}/Π(ν-m)
Uniqueness argument: expansion identity for all x+h forces all constants zero
methods.quote: nun soll aber für alle Werthe von $(x+h)$ $a=b$ sein, was bekanntlich nur statt finden kann, wenn alle Constanten null sind; dann aber sind beide Entwicklungen identisch.
